scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run --workspace admin dev" "npm run --workspace api dev"
scripts.dev:backend: concurrently "npm run --workspace api dev" "npm run --workspace workers/catalog-events dev" "npm run --workspace workers/inventory-alerts dev"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run --workspace api dev" "npm run --workspace workers/catalog-events dev" "npm run --workspace workers/inventory-alerts dev" "npm run --workspace admin dev" "npm run --workspace frontend dev"
scripts.build: npm run --workspace admin build && npm run --workspace api build
scripts.deploy: npm run --workspace admin build && npm run --workspace api deploy
scripts.lint: npm run --workspace admin lint && npm run --workspace api lint
scripts.type-check: npm run --workspace admin type-check && npm run --workspace api type-check
